intent_en: To demonstrate the effectiveness of the smallpox eradication program, using the elimination of cases in India as evidence for its global success.
previous_intent: To demonstrate the effectiveness of the smallpox eradication program globally, using India's complete elimination of reported cases after a 1974 peak as a key example of success.
chart_support: Line chart showing reported smallpox cases in India from 1962 to 1974, highlighting the elimination of cases (sharp decline to baseline) after a peak in 1974.
evidence_note: Narration claims global success ('worked really well', 'around the world'); chart provides specific evidence for India showing case elimination.
